features: Your client now stays connected when the control plane restarts. Previously any brief control-plane outage dropped every tunnel served by a regional edge (#1306).
After being moved off a gateway that is shutting down, your client no longer bounces straight back to it -- the return trip used to cost a reconnection (#1310).
Gateways are now drained before a restart: connected clients are told in advance and move to another gateway first, so deploys stop interrupting live tunnels (#1305, #1238).
A gateway that is restarting stops accepting new tunnels rather than handing out sessions seconds before it goes away (#1238).
Signing in to the portal now survives a gateway restart -- you are no longer logged out by a deploy (#1304).
A tunnel's public URL no longer changes when your client moves between regions; the region lives in DNS rather than in the name visitors type (#1285).
Visitors arriving at the wrong gateway while DNS catches up are forwarded to the one actually serving the tunnel, instead of seeing an offline page (#1249).
DNS records now follow a tunnel to whichever gateway is serving it (#1247).
Certificates are issued and renewed through Route53, and renewals are distributed to the regional edges automatically (#1297, #1302).
Portal fixes: the View As bar is positioned correctly and System Settings is no longer shown to users who cannot use it (#1289); the Analytics time-range control no longer clips its own text (#1293).
The client installer now registers itself with LDM, so auto-discovery works without downloading a second copy (#1311).
feat(client): move off a gateway before its scheduled stop (#1280)
fix(server): make the shutdown-warning path observable and refresh schedules (#1273)
fix(server): stop reporting a connected edge as Offline (#1272)
feat(ci): sign release checksums with minisign when a key is configured (#1269)
fix(provisioner): reject swapped schedule times and apply start before stop (#1268)
fix(client): explain an unsigned release instead of reporting a bare 404 (#1267)
fix(server): answer 503 for a tunnel that moved and 404 for one that never existed (#1263)
fix(ops): bake deployment defaults into the binaries deploy-clients publishes (#1262)
ci(release): report which deployment defaults a release is built with (#1261)
fix(client): bound the registration handshake so an unreachable gateway fails fast (#1260)
fix(client): only announce the tunnel once it is actually connected (#1259)
